text:
Nina Gomez: Quick sync on Autoscale modal mock. Two complaints from usability testing: 1) users don't know if 'Burst' is per-pool or global. 2) the SLO slider label is ambiguous.
Owen (Design): Proposal: change 'Burst' -> 'Burst capacity (per pool)'. Add a small inline tag under pool name: 'Applies only to the selected pool'.
Priya Rao: Love the explicit tag. Also propose a tiny help link 'How burst works' opening a tooltip with an ordered list: 1) adds instances for short events, 2) respects routing/fallback, 3) billed per-granularity.
Samir Patel: From infra POV, we should show the max burst available given pool headroom. Add a read-only number: 'Available to burst: 3 GPUs'.
Owen (Design): UX layout thought: stack controls vertically on narrow screens: Pool picker -> Min/Max sliders -> Burst row -> SLO slider. On wide screens, put burst beside min/max but visually grouped.
Rae (a11y): A11y items: the pool picker needs aria-haspopup and aria-expanded states. For burst control, use aria-describedby linking to the 'How burst works' text. Ensure the SLO slider has aria-valuetext with units ("target tail latency 200 ms").
Nina Gomez: Copy tweak for the slider label: change 'SLO' -> 'Target tail latency (ms)' and append a microcopy line: 'Targets p95 latency unless you've selected a different percentile'.
Priya Rao: Can we surface percentile selection inline? Maybe a compact dropdown next to the slider: p50 | p95 | p99. Default p95.
Samir Patel: Implementation note: dropdown choice needs to be included in the rollout plan because it affects autoscale algorithm. I'll flag to eng-sre.
Rae (a11y): Focus order must follow visual order. Also keyboard controls for the slider: left/right arrows decrement by step; shift+arrow for bigger jumps. Add visible focus outline.
Owen (Design): Visual guardrail: if Min + Burst > pool capacity show a yellow banner: 'Warning: configured capacity may exceed pool limits'. Add two actions: 'Open pool' and 'Reduce burst'. Non-blocking.
Priya Rao: Cost preview: when users change burst or granularity, update cost preview panel. Show a small spinner while fetching, then 'Estimated cost: $0.27/hr (+burst)'. Also include an inline note about rounding rules.
Rae (a11y): Ensure the cost preview update triggers an aria-live polite announcement: 'Cost preview updated: estimated hourly cost 27 cents'.
Nina Gomez: QA asks for an e2e test case: open modal, tab through controls, change burst granularity, assert aria-live announcement and warning banner appears when expected.
Samir Patel: We'll add backend validation so API returns a 'capacity_warning' field. UI should surface it but not block saving.
Owen (Design): Micromcopy: replace 'Granularity' with 'Burst step size' to reduce ambiguity. Options: 1 GPU, 2 GPUs, 4 GPUs. Tooltip: 'Billing and allocation round up to this step'.
Priya Rao: Suggest small inline example: 'If you set step size 4 and burst 1 step, you'll be billed as 4 GPUs for the burst.'
Rae (a11y): One more: ensure radio buttons for step size have clear labels and are reachable by screen reader without additional context. Add visually-hidden text "for pool <pool-name>" to each option's aria-label.
Nina Gomez: Great. I'll update the figma frames and post a new link here. Action owners: Owen finalize layout and copy, Priya add examples and cost copy, Samir update API + capacity_warning, Rae will review accessibility after the update.
DeployBot: No deployments affected.
Nina Gomez: Thanks team 44d Ill ping again when frames are ready.
